desc: Implement trial-division pre-filter using small primes to quickly reject composites before Miller-Rabin.
Iterate k = 1, 2, 3, ... up to a cap (e.g., 10^6) computing p = k * N + 1; if p > 10^18, break.
Test p for primality; on first prime, proceed.
Factor p-1 = k*N (using trial division on N and k separately, then merging unique prime factors).
Find a primitive root g mod p by testing candidates g = 2, 3, 5, ... against each prime divisor q of p-1.
Compute A = pow(g, (p-1)//N, p); this satisfies ord_p(A) = N.
Validate A ≤ 10^18 and p ≤ 10^18 (both hold by construction).
